validation_parity.error_indices_note: Source validation records omit wrong_indices; official test records include them.

validation.mask_order: Integer0..15; bit i=present branch i; mask15=dense, mask0=all four body branches removed
validation.logit_perturbation_definition: Class-center each mask/example logit vector and subtract centered dense logits; dense perturbation is exactly zero; invariant to common per-mask/example logit shifts

centered_logit_delta_walsh.measure: Mean squared function value over uniform16 masks and remaining array coordinates; no seed-based uncertainty

centered_logit_delta_mobius.basis: 0/1 presence monomials, anchored at all-removed mask0
centered_logit_delta_mobius.warning: Möbius coefficient magnitudes are not an orthogonal energy decomposition; context changes can contain degree3/4 contributions.

ce_delta_walsh.measure: Mean squared function value over uniform16 masks and remaining array coordinates; no seed-based uncertainty

correctness_delta_walsh.measure: Mean squared function value over uniform16 masks and remaining array coordinates; no seed-based uncertainty

validation.nonlinearity_warning: CE and argmax can create high-order mask interactions even when centered logits are exactly additive. Loss/correctness degree is not a direct measure of serial computational path length.

spearman_dense_margin_vs_pruned_accuracy.inference: descriptive only; no p-value or confidence interval

spearman_dense_margin_vs_retention_given.inference: descriptive only; no p-value or confidence interval

classification.aggregation: Uniform masks within each cardinality, then uniform examples; conditional retention restricts to examples correct at mask15. No mask is a separate seed replicate.

risk_coverage.selection_rule: Descending dense top1-top2 logit margin, stable original-index tie break; no labels or pruned logits in ranking
risk_coverage.limitation: Dense logits are required, so this is a diagnostic of predictable robustness, not an inference-compute saving policy.

probe_batch_numerics.note: Mechanism corners recomputed at the same batch shape as fractional-gain and gradient probes.

mechanisms.probe_order: Caller-supplied fixed policy-fit prefix; records preserve its order
mechanisms.gradient_convention: CE sum gives per-example downstream gradients; delta is detached post-ReLU bypass minus full state
mechanisms.finite_difference_convention: Centered logits under post-block state +/- epsilon*direction; two steps; Gaussian direction norm matches delta
mechanisms.survival_mean_bias_convention: One branch sampled at its checkpoint-epoch survival probability, all other branch gains fixed at one; not the joint training-mask expectation
mechanisms.first_order_score_convention: 1-SSE(prediction)/SSE(zero change), not R-squared relative to a fitted mean
mechanisms.inference: Descriptive within-checkpoint probes; examples and layers are not independent trained-model replicates
